key_features: Compact 5W Power Output: Tuned full-range driver delivers clear acoustic balance, distinct vocals, and distortion-free audio playback.
Stable Bluetooth Wireless Range: Seamlessly links with smartphones, tablets, and laptops up to 10 meters away for uninterrupted streaming.
Built-in FM Radio Tuning: Access local news, sports, and radio shows directly from the speaker without using mobile data.
TF Memory Card Input: Play your saved offline music playlists directly using a standard micro SD TF card.
Integrated HD Microphone: Answer phone calls easily using hands-free voice transmission with clear call quality.
Rechargeable 500mAh Power Cell: Internal battery charges quickly via modern USB Type-C port for hassle-free daily listening.
